summary: I fixed two off-by-one errors in `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (3 tests). `_cell_lines` wrapped when `len(line) > width - 1`, so lines of exactly `width` characters were split early. It now uses `> width`. `_align` also computed padding as `width - len(text) - 1`, which left cells one space short. It now uses `width - len(text)`.
